description: Find a country, region or "world" destination by name or ISO code. Returns destination codes for list_plans (country: ISO2 like "JP"; region: like "R-EUROPE"; world: "WORLD"), starting prices in USD, and how many data and phone-number plans exist. An empty query lists all destinations.

query.description: Country or region name, or ISO2 code, e.g. "Japan", "JP", "Europe"

name: search_destinations
title: Search destinations
